text:
Adult Shoto Todoroki is so damn beautiful 😍
You already know where you can see him!

Last month we dropped two comics, one of them was the first part of the finale of The Real Winner. You can still read it 😉
This month we're also working on two new stories and we're hoping to finish them on time.
The excitement Gohan gets every time he studies 🥰
Lucas Lee just wants someone to admire his huge, manly feet 🤭

We still have a lot of characters lined up for this month!
Here's Ban and King having a great time together.

Gohan is really the only one who can balance studying and training like a pro 😎
I bet he also likes training barefoot too.

Writing the script for this month's story right now 😊
In the meantime, you can still read last month's: This is your chance, Nakamura-kun! I hope y'all like it.

The beautiful Nanami Kento!
Imagine finally being stuck alone with him at the office, what would you do? 😏

No doubt about it, Megumi definitely inherited Toji's attractiveness 😍
Like father, likes son.
After so many battles, all Mark Grayson wants is a good foot massage. He deserves it!
